correctness.rationale: Project the centered edge cube orthogonally onto the cycle space of a three-path theta graph, with f_i path indicators and intrinsic Euclidean metric. With h=P/S, projected generators p_i=f_i-hg have lengths squared i-h and pairwise dot products -h; the zonotope is a six-vertex equal-radius hexagon with R²=(T-h)/4, Euclidean area sqrt S, and two central-triangle area fractions w_i=i(T-i)/(2S). Dirichlet barycentric triangle moments give I=R²/6 Σw_i(2+c_i) and J=R⁴/45 Σw_i(7+6c_i+2c_i²), reducing to the stated rational formula for J and the previously known I=(ST+P)/(12S). The upper deficit 9/5-J/I²=4(3P²+2S³)/(5(ST+P)²)>0. For a=x,b=x+y,c=x+y+z with x>0,y,z>=0, explicit polynomial certificate for J/I²-168/125 has only nonnegative terms, positive except y=z=0; the a=b=2,c→∞ limit reaches upper 9/5. Independent SymPy expansion/triangle integrations verifies all symbolic identities; the all-positive polynomial and geometry, not 1331 integer samples, establish the theorem on all positive real lengths.
residual_risks: Uniform area on the Voronoi hexagon is not pushforward of uniform ambient cube; wrong measure would invalidate moment formula.
